prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square detailed painterly naturalistic folklore illustration of Buschgroßmutter, the German shrub grandmother. Show one SMALL extremely ANCIENT STOOPED female forest spirit with a deeply wrinkled grey humanlike face, LONG SNOW-WHITE HAIR in wild tangled uncombed strands falling past her waist, and a piercing FIXED STARING gaze. Fully clothed in a plain ragged dark earth-toned wrap and long skirt, two humanlike arms and two legs. She stands hunched among thick undergrowth and ancient roots in the deepest German forest; large ferns and roots establish her small size. One yellow-green leaf rests in her rough hand, referring to her ambivalent gifts. Damp fog and dim cold forest light, severe staring face and tangled white hair create an uncanny forbidding woodland-bogey aura, not a sweet pretty grandmother. Preserve the old small stooped woman form; no glamorous witch, youthful face, tidy hair, pointed hat, broom, horns, wings, tree branch limbs or crown. No victims, attacks, blood or additional characters. Full figure and all long hair within framing. No lettering, labels, runes, border or watermark. Contemporary artistic interpretation of the documented elder forest-spirit variant.
depicted_variant: The small stooped ancient shrub grandmother with long tangled snow-white hair and fixed stare in the deepest forest.
aura: Uncanny primitive forest elder, forbidding and ambivalent rather than kindly storybook grandmother.

visual_review.notes: Ordinary elderly woman with twig-like hair/clothing, essentially human facial and limb structure.
